metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
Warm Up Equipment:
PVC Pipe
Red Band
Box
Rig
1 Round:
30sec e/s PVC Shoulder Opener
5 PVC Around the Worlds each way
5 PVC Pass Throughs
10 Band Row → Rotate → Press
5e/s World’s Greatest Stretch
10 Air Squats
30 Handstand Hold on wall or Plank
2 Rounds:
Gymnastics
5 Scap Pull-Ups
5 Beat Swings
3 Kip Swings
Jog as a team 150m

hypertrophy.reasoning: Pull-ups and gymnastics heavily tax shoulders and triceps; posterior chain work provides GPP without competing for recovery resources.
